result.instructions: Tools for Holdsport (SportMember), hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which activities does my team have this week, and who has not answered yet?"; "Show me the tasks for Saturday's match and who is on snacks."; "Mark me as attending the training on Tuesday.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Holdsport (SportMember) data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run holdsport_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run holdsport_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run holdsport_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. holdsport_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: holdsport_get_user_profile
tools.title: Get user profile
tools.description: The profile of the user this connection acts as: name, id, addresses and contact fields. GET /user.

tools.name: holdsport_list_admin_profiles
tools.title: List administered profiles
tools.description: The profiles this user administers, with their ids. The first entry is the user's own profile. Only a club admin gets more entries. GET /profiles.

tools.name: holdsport_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: The teams this user belongs to, with each team id, colours and the user's role (1 player, 2 coach, 3 assistant coach, 4 injured, 5 inactive, 6 team leader). GET /teams.

tools.name: holdsport_list_team_members
tools.title: List team members
tools.description: The members of one team, with name, id, contact fields and role. GET /teams/{teamId}/members.

tools.name: holdsport_get_team_member
tools.title: Get team member
tools.description: One member of a team, by member id. GET /teams/{teamId}/members/{memberId}.

tools.name: holdsport_list_team_notes
tools.title: List team notes
tools.description: The notes posted for one team: title, body, author and creation time. GET /teams/{teamId}/notes.

tools.name: holdsport_list_team_activities
tools.title: List team activities
tools.description: The activities (training, matches, events) of one team, with start and end times, place, the user's own status and the actions the user may take. Use page and per_page for more results. GET /teams/{teamId}/activities.

date.description: Earliest start date to return, yyyy-mm-dd.

tools.name: holdsport_get_activity
tools.title: Get activity
tools.description: One activity of a team: times, place, comment, the user's status, and the actions the user may take. GET /teams/{teamId}/activities/{activityId}.

tools.name: holdsport_list_activity_attendees
tools.title: List activity attendees
tools.description: The members of an activity with their status (attending, not answered, and so on). GET /activities/{activityId}/activities_users.

tools.name: holdsport_list_activity_tasks
tools.title: List activity tasks
tools.description: The task types of an activity (for example equipment or snacks) with the users assigned to each. GET /activities/{activityId}/activity_tasks.

tools.name: holdsport_set_activity_status
tools.title: Set my status on an activity
tools.description: Changes the status of the connected user on one activity, for example to attend. Use joined_status values from the activity's `actions` list (the docs show 1 for attending). Writes the user's status. POST /activities/{activityId}/activities_users.

joined_status.description: Status value from the activity's `actions` list. The docs use 1 for attending.

picked.description: Set to 1 with attending, as in the docs example. Leave out otherwise.

annotations.title: Set my status on an activity
